messages:
marta: dropped a tiny pass on the trace-list row — aim is to make support flows 1-click while keeping the row visually calm. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/trace-row-polish
kevin: nice direction. first thought: correlation identifier is the primary artifact support copies into tickets. can we prioritize a direct copy affordance without adding weight?
sophia: what about a micro-pill showing first 7 chars + a faint copy icon. clicking copy copies full id. tooltip shows full id and a shortcut hint.
aisha: a11y: tooltip must not be hover-only. provide aria-describedby and ensure the copy control is keyboard focusable. when copied, announce via live region: "Correlation id copied to clipboard".
marta: agreed. design intent: micro-pill (7 chars) + 16px icon, low-contrast. on success replace the icon with a transient label "Copied" for 1.2s (no layout shift). add role=status live region for SRs.
kevin: ordering question: should "Open trace" be a visible action on the row or only in the overflow? quick triage benefits from visible open, but density suffers.
sophia: propose a ghost "Open" button (text only) visible on hover/keyboard focus and always available to keyboard users. on mobile hide it and put inside the expanded sheet.
aisha: ensure focus order is: row link -> micro-id -> copy -> open -> overflow. consistency across breakpoints is crucial.
marta: download/export wording: change from "Export" to "Download trace (JSON)" and add a one-liner: "Includes spans and tags. Toggle 'Attach logs' to include raw request logs (may increase size)." show an approximate size estimate when toggled.
kevin: small enhancement: in download modal, add filename preview defaulting to trace-<id>-full.json and trace-<id>-error.json for the focused option. helps SREs who aggregate dumps.
sophia: stack preview: current layout truncates inside identifiers. use token-aware truncation and prefer showing function name + file:line. keep snippet selectable (monospace).
aisha: keyboard shortcuts: suggest Alt+O to open trace and C for copying id when focus on the pill (with modifier). document them and include the shortcut in the tooltip. tooltips must also expose the shortcut via aria.
marta: analytics: track copy_trace_id, open_trace, download_trace_confirm with props: trace_id, user_role, viewport. will add to spec.
ux-bot: checklist: color contrast for micro-pill, focus outline visible (2px), aria-labels for actions, keyboard order test, reduced-motion for expand animation. link: https://internal.redwood/ux/checklists/trace-rows
marta: thanks — I'll update the component spec with a11y notes, the modal copy, filename behavior, and the analytics events. will push updated frames and ping for a quick review tomorrow.
